name: Makatpur–Danwar District road

tollInfo.note: District roads in India are not tolled.

significance: MDR 88, Makatpur–Danwar District road, crosses the border between Jharkhand and Bihar. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — Jharkhand RCD and Bihar RCD each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
